title: A d-covector on ℝ^{d+1} with coordinates (−1)^i z_i has coefficient norm ‖z‖
statement: Let d ∈ ℕ and z ∈ ℝ^{d+1} = Euclid (d+1), and write e_l := EuclideanSpace.single l 1 and z_i for the i-th coordinate of z. Let ε ∈ Covector (Euclid (d+1)) d be a d-covector with ε(i.removeNth e) = (−1)^i z_i for every i ∈ Fin (d+1), where i.removeNth e = (e_{i.succAbove k})_{k ∈ Fin d}. Then the Euclidean coefficient norm of ε equals the Euclidean norm of z: covectorEuclideanNorm ε = ‖z‖.
lean_statement: ∀ (d : ℕ) (z : Euclid (d + 1)) (ε : Covector (Euclid (d + 1)) d), (∀ i : Fin (d + 1), ε (i.removeNth (fun l : Fin (d + 1) => EuclideanSpace.single l (1 : ℝ))) = (-1 : ℝ) ^ (i : ℕ) * z i) → covectorEuclideanNorm ε = ‖z‖
